info.title: PaHoy API
info.description: API contract generated from the currently routed Django REST Framework endpoints. The URL configuration, views, serializers, and models are the source of truth. Protected API operations use DRF TokenAuthentication. Collection endpoints use DRF page-number pagination with a default page size of 20. Blog, KYC, knowledge, support, billing, and payment models exist or are planned, but no public API routes for them are currently exposed.

onboarding_complete.description: Whether onboarding is complete. The first profile update must provide first_name, last_name, birth_date, and document_id; after completion these fields are optional but cannot be blank when supplied.

TalentProfile.description: Talent profiles returned by search belong to non-anonymous users. Profiles retained after account deletion are excluded.

GigTalentInfo.description: Public profile and location details for the talent who owns the gig.

client_username.description: Username of the assigned client, or null if no client yet.

talent_username.description: Username of the gig talent, or null if the gig relationship is missing.

participants.description: UUIDs of User records participating in the room.

client_user.description: User who created the chat room. Set by trusted server-side creation logic.

contract.description: Optional Contract associated with the message.

sender.description: UUID of the User who sent the message.

LoginError.description: Field and non-field validation errors returned by the email login endpoint.

ContractListItem.description: Contract object returned in list responses, enriched with gig display info and counterparty details relative to the requester.

gig_name.description: Name of the gig associated with the contract.

gig_front_image.description: URL of the gig's front image for card thumbnails.

counterparty_name.description: Username of the other participant. If the requester is the client, this is the talent; if the requester is the talent, this is the client.

counterparty_verified.description: Whether the counterparty's profile is KYC-verified.

counterparty_profile_pic.description: Profile picture URL of the counterparty.
